definitions.gloss: bookmaker; the house; gambling organizer; banker
definitions.explanation: The person or entity that organizes and runs a gambling operation, collecting bets and paying out winnings. By extension, can refer to the organizer or behind-the-scenes operator of any venture.

examples.japanese: {胴元|どうもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{儲|もう}かる。
⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な⟦{賭博|とばく}→賭博：24057_tobaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胴元|どうもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The organizer of an illegal gambling operation was arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦ギャンブル→ギャンブル：10811_gyanburu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最終的|さいしゅうてき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{胴元|どうもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|とく}をする→得をする：30190_tokuwosuru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Gambling is structured so that the house ultimately comes out ahead.

notes: Originally from the world of gambling, where the {胴元|どうもと} is the person who runs the game and takes a cut ({寺銭|てらぜに}) of all bets. The word comes from {胴|どう} (the body of a dice cup) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (origin/owner). By extension, sometimes used figuratively to mean the behind-the-scenes organizer of any operation. Related: ⟦{賭博|とばく}→賭博：24057_tobaku⟧ (gambling — formal), ⟦{賭|か}け{事|ごと}→賭け事：18665_kakegoto⟧ (gambling — general), {寺銭|てらぜに} (the house's cut/commission).
